name: My Sweet Puppy Love
source: Your everyday life is upended when you are chosen to participate in a mystical gameshow, the outcome of which will decide the destiny of three girls you have never even met. Who will you choose to save?
translation: 你被選中參加一檔神秘的遊戲節目，平靜的日常生活從此徹底改變。節目的結果，將決定三個與你素未謀面的女孩的命運。你會選擇拯救誰？
